optional_evidence.chemaware_v2_continuous_null: real only with registered candidate structures and policy; otherwise exact unavailable no-op

excluded_or_downstream.official_finetuned_dreams: comparison baseline and indirect dependency, not a duplicated direct expert
excluded_or_downstream.bioaware: downstream only when real sample-event context is present
excluded_or_downstream.open_set_acceptance: not implemented; input-missing abstention and singleton_hypothesis are not no-match calibration

inference_contract.input: complete aligned query/candidate blocks with seven required score channels and an explicit V2 mode
inference_contract.single_candidate: scored but labelled singleton_hypothesis, not calibrated acceptance
inference_contract.missing_required_evidence: whole nonempty query abstains; candidates are never selectively removed
inference_contract.raw_spectrum_runtime: external upstream assets; not fully embedded in this small package

application_status.known_local_blocker: frozen Noise-MSG fusion_model.joblib and report.json must be present on the execution host
application_status.relation_axis_boundary: the 20,485 all-world cross-mass relation edges are not the Full23 identity axis
